context: Kenji and Ren reflect on the year together at a year-end party.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: レン君、忘年会、お疲れ様。
lines.en: Ren — thanks for tonight. Really made it special.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. Soft opening on the name. Eyes crinkling with real affection, not performance. Steady, unhurried pace. The tone of someone who means what he says and doesn't need to prove it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: It was fun being with everyone.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slight hesitation on the opening, like he's finding the right words. Gentle, unpretentious. Warmth that doesn't call attention to itself. Small, genuine smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一年、本当、頑張ったね、君。
lines.en: You really put in the work this year, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful, steady pace. Slight emphasis on 「truly」 — acknowledging what he's seen. Soft but firm. The tone of someone who notices what others are doing and honors it without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 健次さんの、指導、感謝しています。
lines.en: I'm grateful for your guidance, Kenji-san.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Careful with the honorific — sincere, not performed. Slight catch in the voice, like emotion's there but held in check. Direct, undefended eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ、大切な経験、もらった。
lines.en: I got something really valuable from this too.
lines.style: Gentle, almost reflective. Light pause before 「precious」 — selecting the word deliberately. Warm without reaching for it. The composure of someone secure enough to be soft.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 来年も、よろしく、お願いします。
lines.en: I'm hoping to work with you again next year.
lines.style: Earnest, steady. Slight formality in the phrasing shows respect, but delivery is warm and unguarded. Not rushed. The tone of someone committing to something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Of course. That's what I'm hoping for too.
lines.style: Quiet assurance. Slow, deliberate pace on the closing words. Warm exhale underneath. The unspoken promise of someone who builds loyalty through consistency, not words.
